ValidationRule.description: CR-13 / CAT-07: the line's subscription term must be one the product allows (Product > Allowed Term Months, e.g. Enterprise 24 or 36). Mindbody term-defined lines only.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( BEGINS(Product2.ProductCode, 'MB-'), ISPICKVAL(ProductSellingModel.SellingModelType, 'TermDefined'), NOT(ISBLANK(Product2.Allowed_Term_Months__c)), OR( ISBLANK(SubscriptionTerm), AND(SubscriptionTerm = 12, NOT(INCLUDES(Product2.Allowed_Term_Months__c, '12'))), AND(SubscriptionTerm = 24, NOT(INCLUDES(Product2.Allowed_Term_Months__c, '24'))), AND(SubscriptionTerm = 36, NOT(INCLUDES(Product2.Allowed_Term_Months__c, '36'))), AND(SubscriptionTerm <> 12, SubscriptionTerm <> 24, SubscriptionTerm <> 36) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This contract term is not offered for this product. Use 12, 24 or 36 months as allowed by the product (Enterprise: 24 or 36; TAM: 12).
